clips.name: x01a
clips.text: He just pulled the sword from the stone, and put it back.
clips.heard: He just pulled the sword from the stone and put it back.

clips.name: x02a
clips.text: Wait. Doesn't pulling it out make you king?
clips.heard: Wait, doesn't pulling it out make you king?

clips.name: x03a
clips.text: In the classic Le Morte d'Arthur, outside a London church, a great stone appears, a sword in it.
clips.heard: In the classic Le Morte d'Artur, outside a London church, a great stone appears, a sword in it.

clips.name: x04a
clips.text: Gold letters say: pull it out, and you're king.
clips.heard: Gold letters say, pull it out and you're king.

clips.name: x05a
clips.text: Lords line up to pull, faces turning red, it won't budge.
clips.heard: Lord's line up to pull. Face is turning red. It won't budge.

clips.name: x06a
clips.text: New Year's tournament. Arthur's big brother Kay, a brand-new knight, pats his belt: no sword.
clips.heard: New Year's Tournament. Arthur's big brother Kay, a brand new knight, pats his belt, no sword.

clips.name: x07a
clips.text: Arthur runs back. Nobody's home. All at the tournament.
clips.heard: Arthur runs back. Nobody's home. All at the tournament.

clips.name: x08a
clips.text: He thinks: there's a sword in that stone.
clips.heard: He thinks there's a sword in that stone.

clips.name: x09a
clips.text: Even the ten guards are at the tournament. One tug, and it's out. Pull one.
clips.heard: Even the 10 guards are at the tournament. One tug and it's out. Pull one.

clips.name: x10a
clips.text: Kay takes it straight to Dad: "Dad! The sword! I get to be king!"
clips.heard: Kay takes it straight to dad. Dad! The sword! I get to be king!

clips.name: x11a
clips.text: Dad makes him swear. Kay admits Arthur brought it.
clips.heard: Dad makes him swear. Kay admits Arthur brought it.

clips.name: x12a
clips.text: Dad tells Arthur: put it back and pull again. He says: "How hard can it be?"
clips.heard: Dad tells Arthur, put it back and pull again. He says, how hard can it be?

clips.name: x13a
clips.text: Dad pulls first: stuck. Kay pulls with all his might: stuck. Arthur reaches out: pull two.
clips.heard: Dad pulls first. Stuck. Kay pulls with all his might. Stuck! Arthur reaches out. Pull two.

clips.name: x14a
clips.text: Days later, every lord tries. Only Arthur can. Pull three.
clips.heard: Days later, every Lord tries. Only Arthur can. Pull three.

clips.name: x15a
clips.text: They're furious: "A boy of no high blood, rule us?" They delay it.
clips.heard: They're furious. A boy of no high blood, rule us? They delay it.

clips.name: x16a
clips.text: Next month, snow on the ground: pull four. Delayed.
clips.heard: Next month, snow on the ground. Pull four. Delayed.

clips.name: x17a
clips.text: Spring, flowers in full bloom: pull five. Again.
clips.heard: Spring, flowers in full bloom, pull five, again.

clips.name: x18a
clips.text: Summer, in front of everyone: pull six.
clips.heard: Summer, in front of everyone. Pull six.

clips.name: x19a
clips.text: The people snap: "We want Arthur as king! No more delays!"
clips.heard: The people snap, we want Arthur as king, no more delays.

clips.name: x20a
clips.text: Everyone drops to their knees.
clips.heard: Everyone drops to their knees.

clips.name: x21a
clips.text: Six pulls to make him king. And the first? His brother just forgot his sword.
clips.heard: Six pulls to make him king, and the first, his brother just forgot his sword.
